body: A wrapped loaf and a first-aid kit are tied together with twine and sealed with a strip of barrier tape. A paper tag with only a number on it hangs from the bundle, and the same number is stamped on the kit lid.
title: Relief package, still sealed

body: Two bowls are stacked around a folded scrap with a count written on it. The number served is larger than the number entered in the book, though the food has already been eaten.
title: The missing breakfast tally
